name: Ion Storm
oracle_text: {1}{R}, Remove a +1/+1 counter or a charge counter from a permanent you control: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.
blocked_sentences: {1}{R}, Remove a +1/+1 counter or a charge counter from a permanent you control: This enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.

needs.what: a remove_counters_from_among cost whose `counter` names a set of kinds ("a +1/+1 counter or a charge counter"), so the pool is permanents you control carrying any listed kind and the payer picks the permanent and which listed kind to remove
needs.why_existing_wont_do: remove_counters_from_among takes either no `counter` (any kind, too broad: a loyalty or -1/-1 counter would pay) or one named kind (`_counter_removal_pool`/`_counters_on` read a single string); remove_counters only reads the source. Splitting into two activated abilities, one per kind, would claim the same printed line twice and is two abilities rather than one
